name: images_to_video
description: Make a video from still images: a photo slideshow, a product showcase or a video from generated images. Give a list of images or a folder (sorted naturally by name). Each image shows for seconds_per_image with a transition between them (fade, dissolve, wipes, slides, circle, zoom). Images are fitted to width×height (default 1920×1080; use 1080×1920 for vertical) with a blurred background, padding or cropping. Add background music with audio; it loops if short and fades out at the end.

images.description: Image files in order, relative to the workspace.

folder.description: Folder of images to use (jpg, png, webp, bmp, tif), sorted by name.

seconds_per_image.description: How long each image is shown. Default 3.

transition_seconds.description: Transition length; must be shorter than seconds_per_image. Default 0.6.

fit.description: How images fill the frame: blur (default), pad or crop.

audio.description: Background music or narration file, relative to the workspace.

output.description: Path for the video, relative to the workspace. Default slideshow.mp4 next to the images.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
